posts.name: Ameena
posts.cooked:
It bugs me when people get stuff wrong too...just because "everybody does it" doesn't mean it's right. "Mediums" is one that I hear on telly sometimes, and there used to be this woman called...Doctor something-or-other (but she got her "doctorate" by just sending off for it or something) who did a "health" programme where she'd tell people off for eating junk and get them to crap in a box and inspect the contents to see how bad their diet was...yet she constantly referred to "all those little bacterias". Whaaat?! A so-called "doctor" who specialises in bodily stuff who doesn't know that "bacteria" is already a plural? Arrgh!

People who say stuff like "skellington" when they mean "skeleton" and "Pacific" when they mean "specific" bug me too. And people who say stuff like "would of" and "could of" when they mean "would've" and "could've". And people who use American spellings...even if they're American ;).

Yeah, I'm picky about that stuff. Shock horror :O.
